## Scholarly safeguards

- [ ] No citations, quotations, page numbers, DOIs, or source claims were fabricated.
- [ ] Epistemic states remain explicit.
- [ ] Failure behavior is preserved or strengthened.
- [ ] Researcher decisions are not silently automated.
- [ ] No unpublished manuscript text or personal data is included.
